rv.q: This new musical follows the recent Bend It Like Beckham/Kinky Boots trend of mid-ranking British films being reconceived for the theatre, but how dispiriting it is to see a West End stage in 2016 filled with topless women. I am by no means alone in finding the “it’s all just good, honest fun” argument long expired.
Otherwise, Terry Johnson's production, which cheeries up Stephen Frears's 2005 film, is thin fare.
